notes: Launch-day hardening against mass reporting and bot floods. Every value can be overridden at runtime with the store policy of the same key.

own_posts.notes: 2026-10-24: 6 checks per 600 s is 864 reads a day against ~2,400 publications a day, so most of our posts were never read back (own_post_checks held 3,400 rows, none hidden, while 19 accounts were suspended for hidden posts). 40 per 120 s is 28,800 reads a day: every post is read within minutes of publishing. Posts younger than fresh_seconds come before the backlog, because a post hidden shortly after publishing is the one that suspends the account (three hidden posts and it is gone).

like_pacing.notes: per_day 150 -> 400 (operator 2026-10-20): every account hit 150 by mid-afternoon, leaving pushed posts without likes. The hourly cap keeps likes spread out.
